notes: Fixes updates that silently failed: you click Update, the app downloads it, closes — and reopens on the exact same version, still offering the update, with nothing on screen to say why. Windows was killing the install step the moment the app quit, before it ever got to swap the files in. If you've had to run "Finish update.cmd" to get unstuck, that was this — it should not be needed again.

This is also why the Training & Development expert from 2.9.0 was missing for some of you after clicking Update: you never actually landed on 2.9.0, the update just looked like it worked. It's in this release, along with Probation and Recruitment.
Updates now install through a one-time Windows scheduled task instead of a process the app spawns directly, so the install step survives the app closing.
